name: dropbear
porting_notes: Built on LibTomCrypt 1.18.2 and LibTomMath 1.3.0. Features ChaCha20-Poly1305 (preferred for 68020 - no data cache issues) and AES-128/256-CTR. Supports Ed25519, RSA, ECDSA host keys. Interactive terminal with arrow keys, tab completion, Ctrl-C support via CSI 0x9B translation. Password authentication via DROPBEAR_PASSWORD environment variable or interactive prompt. Entropy from DateStamp + clock + stack address (not cryptographically secure without seed file). Exit code propagation from remote commands. 23/23 FS-UAE automated tests passing. Memory audit: CLEAN. Performance audit: applied. Binary 306 KB at -O0 -m68020.
known_limitations: No ProxyCommand (no fork), no SSH agent forwarding (no AF_UNIX), no X11 forwarding, IPv4 only, no zlib compression, no SCP (future release), public key auth compiled but needs dropbearkey utility (not yet ported)

readme:
Short:        SSH client for AmigaOS (68020+)
Uploader:     duncan (at) example (dot) com
Author:       Matt Johnston (upstream), Duncan Bowring (port)
Type:         comm/net
Version:      2025.89
Architecture: m68k-amigaos >= 3.0
Distribution: Aminet
Requires:     68020+, Roadshow/AmiTCP/Miami TCP/IP stack

Dropbear SSH client (dbclient) for AmigaOS 3.x.

Connects to SSH servers using modern ciphers (ChaCha20-Poly1305,
AES-CTR) and key types (Ed25519, RSA, ECDSA). Interactive terminal
with arrow keys, tab completion, and Ctrl-C support.

Requires a TCP/IP stack (Roadshow, AmiTCP, or Miami) and a 68020+
CPU with 256 KB stack. Tested on A3000/030 via FS-UAE.

Usage:
  ; Set password (optional -- will prompt if not set)
  SetEnv DROPBEAR_PASSWORD mypassword

  ; Connect (auto-accept host key)
  dbclient -y user (at) hostname

  ; Run a single command
  dbclient -y user (at) hostname echo hello

  ; Custom port
  dbclient -y -p 2222 user (at) hostname

Features:
  - ChaCha20-Poly1305 (preferred -- no data cache on 68020)
  - AES-128/256-CTR (compatibility)
  - Ed25519, RSA, ECDSA host keys and signatures
  - Curve25519, DH group14 key exchange
  - Password auth (interactive prompt or DROPBEAR_PASSWORD env)
  - Arrow keys work in remote shells (CSI translation)
  - Tab completion, Ctrl-C, backspace, tilde-dot disconnect
  - Exit code propagation from remote commands

Limitations:
  - No ProxyCommand (-J) -- AmigaOS has no fork()
  - No SSH agent forwarding -- no AF_UNIX sockets
  - No X11 forwarding
  - IPv4 only (no IPv6)
  - No zlib compression (saves RAM)
  - No SCP (separate binary, future release)
  - Public key auth compiled in but needs dropbearkey
    utility (not yet ported) for key generation

Built with LibTomCrypt 1.18.2 + LibTomMath 1.3.0.
309 KB binary, 23 automated tests passing.

This is an amiport project port. See https://amiport.platesteel.net
